run_falign_cuda: run the falign CUDA forced alignment on emissions and target tensors to get the optimal alignment path
run_falign_cuda_step_kernel: run the falign CUDA step kernel for a single time step of the forward pass with backtracking
build_falign_extension: build the falign inline CUDA extension module using torch.utils.cpp_extension.load_inline with O3 optimization
review_falign_cuda_step_kernel: review the falign CUDA step kernel that computes alpha values and backtrack indices for CTC alignment
refactor_falign_cuda: refactor the falign CUDA function to support batched emissions and target tensors for parallel alignment
